Land Allocation & Payment Sign-Off

By proceeding with this transaction, you acknowledge and agree to the following binding terms:

Clause 1 — Pre-Checkout Inspection & Satisfaction: Checkout requires prior completion of physical or virtual property inspection. By initiating payment, you confirm you (or your authorized representative) have inspected the land, verified its condition, and logged your status as Satisfied within the platform.

Clause 2 — Title Verification, Due Diligence & Allocation Window: MainTown Realty conducts automated and preliminary verification of the title documents supplied by the Seller (C of O, Deed of Assignment, Governor's Consent, Gazette or layout plans). That verification is not legal due diligence, a Land Registry search or a certificate of title. You acknowledge that final legal due diligence, the physical search at the Land Registry, independent survey checks and title verification are your own responsibility and must be completed before you execute this Contract. Physical allocation is executed upon the Seller's title warranties being satisfied and adherence to the agreed payment plan.

Clause 3 — Automated Non-Custodial Split Payments: All payments (outright or installment) are processed instantly via automated payment split logic directly to the designated accounts of the Seller/Developer and MainTown Realty. MainTown Realty operates as a non-custodial facilitator and does not hold or escrow transaction funds.

Clause 4 — Installment Schedule, Grace Period & Default: Installments are due according to the selected schedule and are scheduled part-payments of the agreed purchase price; no interest or finance charge is added. A mandatory 30-day grace period applies to overdue payments, after which a written notice of default is issued with a 14-day cure period. Payments remaining in default beyond 60 days without cure trigger automated contract restructuring or property forfeiture, subject to administrative charges.

Clause 5 — Contract Countersignature & Document Dispatch: Upon checkout, the generated Contract of Sale is routed to the Seller for countersignature under platform response windows. Upon 100% completion of the purchase price and processing fees, the Seller is obligated to issue and upload the Deed of Assignment and primary title instruments, delivered securely to you by SmartyHub Logistics, MainTown's delivery partner, at no cost to you, with pick-up within 24 to 48 hours of the Seller's dispatch request.

Clause 6 — Territorial Scope & Interest-Free Instalments: MainTown's structured payment plans of up to 12 months are available only for land and property located within the Federal Republic of Nigeria. Buyers who live abroad may purchase Nigerian property subject to identity verification. Each instalment is a scheduled part-payment of the agreed purchase price, and no interest or finance charge is added.

Clause 7 — Dispute Resolution (Mediation, then LCA Arbitration): Any dispute arising from or connected with these terms, a tenancy or a purchase made through MainTown Realty is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and Lagos State and is resolved in three steps. (1) Notice: the claimant gives written notice of the dispute through the in-app Dispute Centre or by email. (2) Mandatory mediation: for 14 days from receipt of that notice the parties must try in good faith to settle the dispute by informal mediation, facilitated by a MainTown Realty dispute officer or another neutral mediator the parties agree, and no arbitration may be started until those 14 days have ended. (3) Arbitration: if the dispute is not settled within the 14 days, it is finally resolved by a sole arbitrator under the Rules of the Lagos Court of Arbitration (LCA) in force when the dispute is referred. The seat and venue of arbitration is Lagos, the language is English, and the award is final and binding. Nothing in this clause stops a party from seeking urgent interim relief from a court, from bringing proceedings for recovery of possession that require a court order under the Recovery of Premises Law of Lagos State, from reporting suspected fraud to law enforcement, or from complaining to a competent regulator. Each party bears its own costs unless the tribunal directs otherwise, and the arbitration and any award are confidential except where disclosure is needed to enforce the award or comply with law.

Section 8: Default & Grace Period Tracker

Stage 1 — Grace Period (Days 1–3)

Payment is late but within the grace window. Reminders only — no charge is applied.

Stage 2 — Late Notice (Days 4–7)

A formal late notice is issued. A single fixed Late Administration Fee, disclosed in your Payment Schedule, may apply. No interest or daily percentage penalty accrues.

Stage 3 — Formal Demand (Days 8–14)

A written Demand for Payment is issued and a default flag is recorded. New bookings are paused and the 14-day mediation period opens.

Stage 4 — Statutory Recovery (Day 15+)

If arrears remain unpaid, the Landlord may serve the statutory notices and apply to court under the Recovery of Premises Law of Lagos State. No eviction takes place without due process.
